events.title: Marriage to widow Maria Magdalena (Grub) Ihrig
events.description: Her first husband Johannes Ihrig died 1788; her 1801 St. John's Lutheran death entry names her as wife of Johann G. Stecher, previously wife of Johann Ihrig, née Grub. [R4-S1]

bio: Johann Georg Stecher married Maria Magdalena Grub (b. 6 May 1759, d. 27 Dec 1801), widow of Johannes Ihrig (d. 1788), after 1788. Andreas Grub's 1791 will calls her 'Mary the wife of George Stacher', and her 1801 death entry at St. John's Lutheran, Easton, names both husbands and her maiden name ([R4-S1]). In 1790 George Stecher's Forks Township household had three males over 16 and ten females, possibly including the aged Andreas Grub ([R4-S1]). The Stechers also married into the Doll family (Christopher Stecher, said to have married Elizabeth Doll), which points to overlapping Grub-Stecher-Doll circles in Forks Township.
